corrections.old_basis: Missing pressed bit six or nonnegative WeaponStateCooldown reaches this branch, which clears D0 and returns.
corrections.new_basis: Clear pressed bit six reaches this zero-D0 return directly. With bit six set, down held toggles Seven Forces shooting mode first; only the no-down path tests WeaponStateCooldown and returns here when it is nonnegative.

corrections.old_basis: Shared by the final miss and by all three rising guards.
corrections.new_basis: The final right-outer tile miss and the three negative-velocity guards return here. Each guard tests $1C(a5) after a center or outer tile hit and skips lower-terrain handling while that word is negative.
